encoding: byte & 7 = country (1 KR, 2 KP, 3 JP, 4 CN, 5 other, 6 RU; the sea takes its nearest land cell's); byte & 8 = sea. 0 would be sea with no country (never occurs).
sampling: cell-centred: value (i, j) is at x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, y0 + (j + 0.5) * cell
covers: 24-46 N, 112-148 E (the margin box) and more
